text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I came to pray at the shrine with KS 
Miracle, who hasn't been in top shape 
lately, someone was already there before 
us.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Please, let me be able to ride a bicycle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After making that request, the girl took 
her bicycle parked nearby and began 
practicing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah. Well then, shall we say a 
prayer as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Please, let that girl's wish come true.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not feeling well, I just have to 
deal with it myself.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—To make up for that, maybe if I make a 
wish for her sake, it might just come true 
easier... or so I thought.
choice_data_list: I think it's great, it's very you!

I think it's great because it's so like 
you!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you very much. Hearing you 
say that makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Sis! Did you wish for me to 
be able to ride a bicycle!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah. I saw how hard you were 
trying, so I just wanted to cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Can I help with practice? I might be 
able to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Help me out together! Thank you, Big 
Sis!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly, keep it up! Look forward! 
Keep pedaling!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: W-Wah...! Big sis... am I doing it!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Amazing, amazing! You learned how to 
ride properly!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, big sis! Thanks to you, 
I can finally ride a bike!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, it wasn't because of me. It's because 
you worked so hard. —You did great.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I was a good girl?! —Bye-bye, big 
sis!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, bye-bye. Get home safely, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I feel energized somehow. I'm 
glad your wish came true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, inspired by the little girl's 
determination, K.S. Miracle was able to 
get back into top form.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, straight ahead just like 
that. Ah, no! If you turn the steering 
wheel now—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? ...Whoa!? Eeeek!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle dashed out as fast as the 
wind, catching a falling bicycle just in 
time to save a young girl.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for saving me, big sister... I 
was so scared...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. Good luck with 
your bicycle practice going forward.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Only if I feel like it, okay? 
—Bye-bye, big sis!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I ended up scaring them. I wish I 
could've taught them better.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to make her wish come 
true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a disheartened K.S.Miracle was 
unable to get back into shape...
